cynthia-torres.text: Endorsed by the Los Angeles County Democratic Party for PUSD District 7.

source.title: Pasadena Now: LA County Democrats Endorse 4 Pasadena Unified Board Candidates

cynthia-torres.text: Says PUSD needs "a long-term financial strategy that reflects the realities of enrollment, expenses, and available resources"; cites 11 years on Santa Monica-Malibu USD's Financial Oversight Committee, including as chair.

source.title: MY VISION | Cynthia Torres for PUSD School Board (campaign site)

cynthia-torres.text: "PUSD should not limit its thinking to the revenue it receives today"; will pursue strategic fundraising, corporate and philanthropic partnerships, asset management and outside investment.

source.title: MY VISION | Cynthia Torres for PUSD School Board (campaign site)

cynthia-torres.text: Wants rigorous math access for every student, expanded vocational training and credentialing pathways, and "expanded college and career counseling for every student."

source.title: MY VISION | Cynthia Torres for PUSD School Board (campaign site)

cynthia-torres.text: In the party's release Torres said, "I come from a labor family," and that her experiences taught her the importance of standing up for working families.

source.title: Pasadena Now: LA County Democrats Endorse 4 Pasadena Unified Board Candidates

dennis-j-mcnamara.text: McNamara said he wants to "channel that energy into strengthening classroom instruction, expanding opportunities for every student," citing dual-language immersion, International Baccalaureate and the partnership with Pasadena City College as district strengths.

source.title: Pasadena Now: McNamara Hopes to Win School Board District 7 Seat (July 2026)

dennis-j-mcnamara.text: McNamara chairs the Citizens' Oversight Committee monitoring the district's $1.4 billion Measures O and R school modernization program and is a former Western Asset Management executive (budgeting, staffing, information systems).

source.title: Pasadena Now: McNamara Hopes to Win School Board District 7 Seat (July 2026)
